meta.name: grill-with-docs
meta.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design, which also creates docs (ADR's and glossary) as we go.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在讨论中完善设计并同步产出文档
copy.tagline_en: Sharpen plans through relentless questioning while generating docs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to refine designs through discussion and produce docs simultaneously

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会通过持续提问帮你完善计划或设计，并同时生成架构决策记录和术语表。
howto.when: 当你需要梳理或优化一个计划、设计方案时，可以主动要求启动该技能。

say.text: 我们来做一个关于新功能的 grilling 会话。
say.note: 启动技能，开始提问和记录。

say.text: 帮我完善这个设计方案，并生成 ADR。
say.note: Claude 会追问细节并输出文档。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will run a relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design, and create ADRs and a glossary as you go.
howto.when_en: When you need to refine or optimize a plan or design, you can ask to start the session.

say_en.text: Let's run a grilling session for the new feature.
say_en.note: Starts the skill, Claude will ask questions and document.

say_en.text: Help me refine this design and generate ADRs.
say_en.note: Claude will probe details and output docs.
